name: claude-role-skills
description: Claude Code skills by role. Each skill does one repeated job, counts with its own scripts, and ends in one self-contained web page.

plugins.name: software-engineering
plugins.description: Ten skills for software engineers: codebase-map, impact, bug-hunt, test-gap, dependency-audit, code-audit, change-review, docs-draft, incident-triage and postmortem.

plugins.name: ai-architect
plugins.description: Four skills for AI solutions architects: ai-pattern, ai-stack, ai-architecture and ai-review.

plugins.name: data-architect
plugins.description: Four skills for data architects: data-platform, data-model, data-map and data-review.

plugins.name: data-engineer
plugins.description: Seven skills for data engineers: source-profile, source-contract, pipeline-incident, data-quality, data-cost, data-migration and data-product.

plugins.name: software-architect
plugins.description: Four skills for software architects: arch-style, arch-c4, arch-review and arch-evolve.

plugins.name: cloud-architect
plugins.description: Three skills for cloud architects: cloud-map, cloud-design and cloud-review.

plugins.name: solutions-architect
plugins.description: Two skills that sit on top of the specialist packs and own the whole: solution-brief and solution-blueprint. Installing it installs the four specialist packs.

plugins.name: data-analyst
plugins.description: Four skills for data analysts: metric-spec, number-moved, number-reconcile and report-review.

plugins.name: data-scientist
plugins.description: Five skills for data scientists: ds-frame, ds-explore, ds-dataset, ds-evaluate and ds-experiment.

plugins.name: workflows
plugins.description: Seven process workflows that chain the other packs' skills: take-over, ship-change, incident-run, data-incident, new-solution, platform-month and model-build.
